page.title: Notifications
page.description: Your attendance, steward, race and league updates.
page.emptyHint: Attendance, steward and race updates will show up here.

push.title: Push on this device
push.description: Get alerts on your phone even when ISL is closed.
push.enabled: Push is enabled on this device.
push.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site in your browser settings. Allow them, then try again.
push.unsupported: This browser doesn't support push notifications.
push.installRequired: Install the ISL app first: use your browser's “Add to Home Screen” / “Install app”, then open ISL from the installed app to enable push.
push.error: Couldn't enable push — please try again.
push.masterOffHint: Push is enabled on this device, but “Enable push notifications” below is off, so nothing will be sent.

prefs.title: Notification settings
prefs.description: Choose what you're notified about and how. In-app notifications always keep a history of important personal updates.
prefs.pushGlobalHint: Master switch. Per-device permission is set separately when push launches.
prefs.pauseOptionalHint: Silences non-essential alerts. Critical schedule and personal steward updates still arrive.
prefs.articleAnnouncementsPushOnlyHint: Other articles still appear in your notifications list.

categoryHint.attendance: RSVP opens, reminders, and changes to your status.
categoryHint.race: Time, date, cancellation and grid changes.
categoryHint.steward: Cases you're involved in, deadlines and decisions.

prefs.testDescription: Send yourself a test notification to check the bell.
prefs.testSent: Test notification sent — check the bell.

attendance_opened.title: Attendance is open: {race}

attendance_missing.title: You haven't RSVP'd: {race}
attendance_missing.body: Set your attendance before the deadline.

attendance_changed_by_admin.title: Your attendance was updated: {race}
attendance_changed_by_admin.body: An admin set your status to {status, select, going {Going} maybe {Maybe} out {Not racing} other {{status}}}.

race_time_changed.title: Start time changed: {race}
race_time_changed.body: Check the new time so you don't miss the lights.

race_cancelled.title: Race cancelled: {race}
race_cancelled.body: This race will no longer take place.

race_postponed.title: Race postponed: {race}
race_postponed.body: A new date will be announced.

steward_case_involved.title: You're involved in a steward case
steward_case_involved.body: Open the case to review the details.

steward_response_needed.title: Your response is needed
steward_response_needed.body: A steward case is waiting for your statement.

steward_verdict_published.title: A steward decision was published
steward_verdict_published.body: See the outcome of your case.

steward_penalty_assigned.title: You have a penalty to serve

appeal_verdict_published.title: An appeal decision was published
appeal_verdict_published.body: See the outcome of the appeal.

results_corrected.title: Results updated: {race}
results_corrected.body: A steward decision may have changed your result.

admin_broadcast.body: The league has posted an update.
